---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem using synthetic evidence
title: ""
labels: bug
---

## Version and host

State the skill revision, Python version, operating system, assistant/host, and mode.

## Expected and actual behavior

Describe the observable difference.

## Synthetic reproduction

Include the smallest synthetic snapshot, plan, or prompt that reproduces the issue. Do not include private device evidence, keys, pairing codes, identifiers, endpoints, or screenshots. For a vulnerability, follow SECURITY.md instead.

## Validation and recovery

State which checks ran and whether any real device state changed. Do not perform further live tests just to file an issue.
